title: 第17章 高，实在是高！
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
为什么意外？

    那是因为业务能力、工作经验、年龄和背景，这几项要素一向是决定县委书记联络员人选的主要条件。按照惯例，几乎不可能选择一个刚入职的生瓜蛋子！

    为什么不十分意外？

    那是因为咱们的宋书记向来我行我素，刚愎自用。凡事只要他觉得，不要别人觉得。

    就拿联络员的人选来说，宋书记觉得行，那不行也行。宋书记觉得不行，行也不行。

    上次安排的联络员冯成轩，无论文字功底、沟通能力，以及领会领导意图上都称得上出色，但偏偏没过多长时间，就被宋书记一脚踢了回来。

    究其主要原因，竟然是宋书记嫌冯成轩长得丑，带出去丢人……

    凭良心说，冯成轩的长相其实没那么磕碜，但书记大人就是看着碍眼，那有什么办法？

    “好的书记，那我回头通知小梁，您看他什么时候过来合适？”刘运生眼中闪过一抹喜色，心中暗自得意，嘿嘿，一切尽在他的算计当中。

    “那就十一过后吧。嗯，稿子先留下，我再仔细看看。”宋启贤淡淡回了一句，又拿起稿子看了起来。

    尽管这篇稿子已经很好了，但要是不改上两段，岂不是显得他这个当领导的没有水平？

    刘运生十分识相地退了出去，并将房门轻轻关上。

    宋启贤抬眼瞥了下房门，嘴角露出一丝不屑的冷笑。

    刘运生方才的小表情，并没有逃过他的眼睛，他敢断定，这厮十有八九是收了别人的好处，否则不可能这么卖力地给梁惟石吆喝。

    只不过嘛，水至清则无鱼，念在刘运生对他还算忠心耿耿的份儿上，他也懒得计较了。

    刘运生回去将宋书记的决定传达给了汪荣华，后者不禁大吃一惊。

    是的，汪副主任万万没想到，宋书记竟然会选择一个刚刚参加工作半月不到的新丁做联络员！

    不对，这其中必有内幕！
content_en:
Why the surprise?

That's because business ability, work experience, age and background have always been the main criteria for determining the candidate for the county party secretary liaison officer.As usual, it is almost impossible to choose a new employee!

Why not very surprised?

That's because our Secretary Song has always had his own way of doing things.He only needs to think about everything, not what others think.

Take the selection of liaison officers as an example. If Secretary Song thinks it’s OK, it’s fine if it doesn’t.Secretary Song thinks it won’t work, and it won’t work either.

The liaison officer assigned last time, Feng Chengxuan, was excellent in terms of writing skills, communication skills, and understanding of the leadership's intentions. However, it didn't take long for him to be kicked back by Secretary Song.

The main reason turned out to be that Secretary Song thought Feng Chengxuan was ugly and wanted to take him out to embarrass him...

Frankly speaking, Feng Chengxuan's appearance is not that ugly, but the secretary is just an eyesore, so what can be done?

"Okay secretary, then I will inform Xiaoliang later, when do you think it is a good time for him to come over?" Liu Yunsheng's eyes flashed with joy, and he was secretly proud in his heart, hey, everything was all according to his plan.

"Then after National Day. Well, let's keep the manuscript for now, and I'll take a closer look." Song Qixian replied lightly, then picked up the manuscript and read it again.

Although this manuscript is already very good, if the last two paragraphs are not changed, wouldn’t it mean that he is not a good leader?

Liu Yunsheng withdrew very wisely and closed the door gently.

Song Qixian raised his eyes and glanced at the door, with a disdainful sneer on his lips.

Liu Yunsheng's little expression just now did not escape his eyes. He dared to conclude that this guy was most likely taking advantage of others, otherwise he would not have been able to yell at Liang Weishi so hard.

It's just that if the water is clear, there will be no fish. Considering that Liu Yunsheng is still loyal to him, he doesn't bother to care about it.

Liu Yunsheng went back and conveyed Secretary Song's decision to Wang Ronghua, who was shocked.

Yes, Deputy Director Wang never expected that Secretary Song would choose a newcomer who had just started working for less than half a month as the liaison officer!

No, there must be something behind this!
